mentions.name: Vela
mentions.description: Vela is a Vulkan 1.4-based desktop environment built on wlroots with a custom renderer, aiming to be faster than Plasma with a focus on fractional scaling, sharpness, and usability. A benchmark suite under development shows roughly 40% lower RAM usage, 40% faster input lag, lower CPU usage in some activities, and faster responsiveness during high CPU usage from other tasks.
mentions.problem: Existing desktop environments are heavier and slower; the project targets lower RAM usage, reduced input lag, and better responsiveness under high CPU load.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vela! A new desktop environment made to use just Vulkan 1.4, expecting to be faster than Plasma* and made with wlroots, but using a custom renderer. It has focus on fractional scaling, sharpness and usability.
